summary: iter123 — Full backend + Customer app UI verification for header/logo rule, category page + services, Membership page & buy flow, top-anchored Location sheet, hero autoplay, regression, and Expo Android bundle. Backend: 8/8 pytest cases pass (memberships plans/me/buy-mock; catalog categories & services; geo serviceability 800001 → Patna Central; admin app-home branding.logo set/restore round-trip via cache-busted public GET /api/app/home). Membership plans slugs = ['gold-plus','platinum-elite','silver-saver']; POST /memberships/order returns mock=true (no razorpay keys), POST /memberships/mock activates; GET /memberships/me returns active=true after mock. Frontend @ http://localhost:3001 (390x844): landing-page renders. HEADER: app-logo(wordmark)+app-tagline visible when branding.logo empty. HERO: hero-slide-0 shown first ('Home Services'), autoplayed to hero-slide-1 ('Trusted Experts') within ~6s; dots update; hero-slide-0/1 both in DOM. CATEGORIES: 6 app-cat-<id> tiles (3-col grid with images) + app-cat-more 'All services'. CATEGORY PAGE: /(site)/category/9f33a27e... loads category-page with category-title='AC Repair & Service', category-count='3 services' (matches API), category-svc-0..2 with rating (4.8), duration (90 min), From ₹2,499 and Book Now; category-loading-more ABSENT (≤8 svcs); category-back returns to landing. MEMBERSHIP: bn-membership → membership-page with membership-plans and plan-card-silver-saver/plan-card-gold-plus/plan-card-platinum-elite. Logged-out buy-silver-saver text='Sign in to buy', tapping shows toast 'Please sign in to buy a membership' and navigates to /login. After demo-customer login, buy-silver-saver='Current Plan' (customer already active from backend buy-mock test), buy-gold-plus='Get Gold Plus', buy-platinum-elite='Get Platinum Elite'. my-membership banner shows 'Silver Saver — Active · 5% off every booking · valid till 2027-09-25 · Total saved ₹0'. membership-back returns to landing. LOCATION SHEET (top-anchored): tapping app-location-pill opens app-location-sheet on FIRST tap (iter122's extra-tap workaround no longer required — pill single-tap opens sheet directly). testIDs verified: app-location-close, app-location-input, app-location-set, app-location-detect, app-location-city-patna, app-location-city-ranchi. Typing 800001 → app-location-pincode-badge 'We serve your area' → app-location-set → pill text becomes 'Patna Central'. Reopen sheet → app-location-current chip 'Patna Central Current'; tapping app-location-city-ranchi → pill becomes 'Ranchi'. app-location-close hides sheet. LOGO RULE: admin PUT /api/admin/app-home with branding.logo=<pexels URL> → cache-busted reload shows app-logo-image PRESENT + app-tagline ABSENT (visually: only logo image, no 'AzoApp' wordmark, no tagline). Restore logo='' → app-logo-image absent, app-tagline present (wordmark + tagline). Both public GET /api/app/home responses reflect changes immediately. REGRESSION: app-offer-banner + app-offer-copy toast, app-quick-features/app-most-booked/app-why-choose/app-trending/app-offers all render (lazy — appear after scrolling in FlatList). app-search-bar + app-voice-btn present. bn-bookings while logged out → /login (login-page uses a different testid; login screen visually confirmed). Partner 9000000003 has role='partner' via /auth/verify-otp; the Customer-app blocking is client-side (not re-driven this run). Expo Android bundle HTTP 200. BUG (STILL PRESENT — iter121 + iter122 unresolved): after customer login, bn-bookings navigates to /(customer)/orders but page-title renders '(customer)' instead of 'My Bookings'. Same RCA as iter122 (params.tab returns '(customer)' route-group value on expo-router web).

ui_bugs.issue: STILL BROKEN after two prior reports (iter121, iter122). After customer login, tapping bn-bookings navigates to /(customer)/orders but page-title shows '(customer)' instead of 'My Bookings'. useLocalSearchParams() returns params.tab='(customer)' (route-group name) on expo-router web; the fallback pathname parser never runs because params.tab is truthy. Fix: `const rawTab = String(params.tab || ''); const tab = rawTab.startsWith('(') ? '' : rawTab; const seg = tab || pathname.split('/').filter(Boolean).filter(x => !x.startsWith('(')).pop() || '';` Then NAV.find(n => n.key === 'orders') → 'My Bookings'.

action_items: (MEDIUM, RECURRING) Patch /app/Customer/app/(customer)/[tab].tsx — strip route-group values ('(...)') from params.tab before using it as the tab key. Bug reported in iter121 & iter122 and remains unfixed; see RCA in iter122 report.
critical_code_review_comments: Header logo rule end-to-end correct: AppHeader shows image-only when branding.logo truthy and hides tagline; wordmark+tagline appear when logo empty. app-logo (container/wrapper) remains as a wrapper testid regardless — visually only image is rendered when logo is set.

Location sheet iter121 workaround gone — single tap on app-location-pill now opens the top-anchored sheet directly. All spec testIDs present (input, set, detect, close, city-patna, city-ranchi, pincode-badge, current chip on reopen).

Category page correctly renders all services (grid of 2-col cards with rating/duration/from-price/Book Now) and omits category-loading-more when list ≤ PAGE (8). Cannot exercise incremental scroll path because seed data has ≤3 services per category — consider seeding a category with >8 services if this path needs runtime verification.

Membership page correctly aligns state to /memberships/me: active plan renders 'Current Plan' + my-membership banner; other plans render 'Get <Name>'; logged-out uses 'Sign in to buy' + toast + /login redirect.
Membership purchase for demo customer 9000000004 remains active (silver-saver) — persistent mock state as noted; not restored by design.
iter122 [tab].tsx bug still unresolved after two reports — E1 appears to be missing the route-group filter on params.tab.

success_rate.frontend: ≈95% — all spec flows verified except recurring bn-bookings page-title bug

seed_data_creation: Demo customer silver-saver membership activated during backend test (persistent, as noted in agent_to_agent_context_note). Admin branding.logo temporarily set to pexels URL during logo-rule test and restored to '' at end (verified via GET /api/app/home).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Re-test only [tab].tsx placeholder fix. Reproduction: 390x844 fresh session, load /, tap bn-account → demo-customer, back to /, tap bn-bookings. Expected page-title='My Bookings', observed '(customer)'. Everything else (logo rule, category page, membership, location sheet, hero autoplay, Expo bundle) passes and does not need re-testing unless the underlying files change.
rca of the issue: See iter122 report — /app/Customer/app/(customer)/[tab].tsx line 14 uses `params.tab` directly; on expo-router web useLocalSearchParams returns the route-group name '(customer)' as params.tab, bypassing the pathname fallback. Fix in one line by treating any params.tab value starting with '(' as empty and falling through to the pathname parser.
